item.title: Liquibase
item.description:
Simple introduction

Liquibase is open source tool for database change and deployment management. provides a database agnostic way to deliver fast, safe, repeatable database deployments, more details please refer to Liquibase website

Support more than 10 databases, like Mysql, Oracle, SQL Server,DB2,etc.
